title: Posted Before the Bend
hook: The ramp owns you. The curve is next.
scene: Overcast morning. You have left I-5. The exit ramp is wet and tightening toward a posted 25. Your cluster still reads highway leftover. The bend is visible. If you carry sixty into a twenty-five the rear will write the number for you. If you stood on it back on the freeway, the stack already paid. The tap belongs here.
decision: You are on the exit ramp. When are you at 25?

options.text: Tap the brakes now and be at the posted number before the curve starts
options.result: You bleed the leftover here. The cluster agrees with the sign before the bend. The Beetle stays straight. The freeway behind you never had to lift.

options.text: Hold sixty until the apex, then stand on it
options.result: The rear steps out mid-bend. Yaw on a wet ramp. You spent the car to keep a number the sign already took from you.

options.text: Coast with no brake and let the hill take the speed out
options.result: There is no hill that saves you. You arrive at the paint still hot. The next car in the line gets your leftover.

options.text: Stop dead on the ramp so the curve is taken from a standstill
options.result: You plant the Menace on an exit ramp. The car behind you came in at ramp speed and had nowhere to put it.

debrief: On the ramp, tap the brakes and be at the posted speed before the curve. The cluster agreed with the sign before the bend.

source.psdp_skill: Skill eleven: highway driving – part one

source.stat_cited: PSDP p.31: Upon entering the ramp, tap the brakes and begin to slow down to the posted exit ramp speed limit before reaching the curve.
